name: Spark
body:
Spark CR 5

XP 1,600
CN Small aberration (air)
Init +10; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +15

DEFENSE

AC 23, touch 23, flat-footed 13; (+5 deflection, +6 Dex, +1 dodge, +1 size)
hp 40 (9d8)
Fort +3, Ref +9, Will +9
Defensive Abilities natural invisibility; Immune magic

OFFENSE

Speed fly 40 ft. (perfect)
Melee shock +11 touch (2d6 electricity)

STATISTICS

Str 1; Dex 23; Con 10; Int 15; Wis 16; Cha 14
Base Atk +5; CMB +0; CMD 23
Feats Alertness, Blind-Fight, Dodge, Improved Initiative, Weapon Finesse
Skills Acrobatics +18, Bluff +11, Escape Artist +18, Fly +28, Perception +17, Stealth +22
Languages Aklo, Common
SQ feed on music

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Feed on Music (Su)

Any time a spark is within 15 feet of a musical event, it gains fast healing 2.

Immunity to Magic (Ex)

Sparks are immune to all spells and spell-like abilities that allow spell resistance, except magic missile and maze.

ECOLOGY

Environment any wilderness
Organization solitary, pair, or skein (3–4)
Treasure incidental

Sparks are easily confused with will-o’-wisps, but sparks have a different, if equally alien, mindset. Sparks are highly attracted to music, song, and pleasant sounds, and will seek out natural locales or dwell near intelligent creatures in order to feed on the sounds of song and music.

Just like will-o’-wisps, sparks can glow any color or hue they choose. At full glow, a spark’s light is equivalent to torchlight. Sparks are aggressive and hostile to will-o’-wisps, and will almost always attack will-o’-wisps if it is possible. Sparks are dangerous to feed, because as they become full on music, they can become agitated and strike out at beings around them. Also, when an instrument or song ceases, sparks will occasionally become violent and attack the musicians out of rage or deprivation.

Sparks are effectively immortal, akin to will-o’-wisps, and have been known to serve as mentors and teachers to those who can strike the right bargain. Typically, this involves musical talents or crafts beyond mere mortal ability.
